sub_questions.text: If $\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{b}$ are consecutive vectors of a parallelogram, express the diagonal vectors in terms of $\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{b}$.

For the position shown in Fig. 2 below, the hydraulic cylinder imparts a velocity and acceleration to slider $A$ of $0.4\text{ m/s}$ and $2\text{ m/s}^2$, respectively, both to the right. A ball is dropped from a height of 25 metres upon a horizontal floor. Find the coefficient of restitution between the floor and the ball, if it rebounds to a height of 16 metres.
